request.description:
Called by Meta during webhook registration. Responds with the hub_challenge
when hub_verify_token matches the configured value.

item.name: Receive inbound WhatsApp messages from Meta.

request.description:
Must include a valid X-Hub-Signature-256 header (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body
signed with WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET). Messages are persisted and queued for AI handling.
